title: Two fills that share OrderID and ExecID on different sessions are counted as one

fixtures.feature: Two venues that both use OrderID 1 / ExecID 1: both fills count, and the orders stay apart
fixtures.basis: Brief 6, 11; FIX: OrderID and ExecID are unique per executing party; AC-041 keys on 37+17 alone

title: Orders of different clients that reuse a ClOrdID are merged, and the Account filter shows the other client's flow

fixtures.feature: The same ClOrdID used by two clients is two orders
fixtures.basis: Brief 6, 7, 11; FIX: ClOrdID is unique per order sender; AC-035 joins on the value alone

fixtures.feature: The Account filter does not show another client's order that reuses a ClOrdID
fixtures.basis: Brief 11; US-009 'one client's flow in a shared log'; AC-051 follows AC-035

title: Clicking an id opens another order when the value is a ClOrdID of one order and the OrderID of another

fixtures.feature: Clicking OrderID 1001 opens the order that has that OrderID
fixtures.basis: AC-034, AC-036 'shows only that order's messages'; design 12 findOrder takes the id alone

title: A trade cancel that stands before its fill in the log is not applied

fixtures.feature: A trade cancel listed before the fill it names still removes that fill
fixtures.basis: AC-041 'as they stand at the end of the log', AC-042, AC-044 'not in the log'; brief 7 (reports before earlier events)

title: After a session restarts at 1 without ResetSeqNumFlag, sequence gaps are no longer found

fixtures.feature: A gap after the session restarts at 1 without ResetSeqNumFlag is still found
fixtures.basis: FIX session protocol: sequence numbers restart at 1 on a new session; TR-003 resets only on 141=Y

title: Sessions told apart only by SubIDs share one sequence counter: missed gaps and false gaps

fixtures.feature: Sessions that differ only by SenderSubID keep separate sequence numbers
fixtures.basis: Brief 11; FIX session identity; TR-003 keys a direction on 49/56 only

fixtures.feature: No false gap when a second SubID session of the same CompIDs runs at higher numbers
fixtures.basis: Brief 11; FIX session identity; TR-003 keys a direction on 49/56 only

title: A MsgSeqNum that was already used, without PossDupFlag, is shown as a normal message

fixtures.feature: A duplicate MsgSeqNum without PossDupFlag is pointed out
fixtures.basis: FIX session protocol, MsgSeqNum lower than expected without PossDupFlag; design 11 says 'Ignored'

title: A resent or duplicated NewOrderSingle is counted as another order in the trading summary

fixtures.feature: A resent NewOrderSingle (PossDupFlag=Y) is not a second order
fixtures.basis: Brief 6: a retransmission is not a new business event; AC-040 counts NewOrderSingle messages

fixtures.feature: A resent NewOrderSingle (PossDupFlag=Y) is not a second order
fixtures.basis: Brief 6: a retransmission is not a new business event; AC-040 counts NewOrderSingle messages

fixtures.feature: A log merged from both sides of a connection does not double orders or fills
fixtures.basis: Brief 11; AC-040 counts NewOrderSingle messages, AC-041 dedupes fills only

title: False sequence gaps after a PossDup message with the expected number, and after a SequenceReset to a lower number

fixtures.feature: A PossDup message with the expected number fills that number: no gap after it
fixtures.basis: FIX session protocol (PossDupFlag: process if MsgSeqNum not yet received); QuickFIX 2e_PossDupNotReceived.def; TR-003 'Messages with PossDupFlag=Y don't advance'

fixtures.feature: A SequenceReset to a lower number is not followed by a false gap
fixtures.basis: FIX SequenceReset: NewSeqNo may only increase the expected number; QuickFIX 11c_NewSeqNoLess.def; TR-003

title: Values that are not FIX numbers are counted as quantities and prices

fixtures.feature: LastQty '0x10' (hexadecimal) is not a FIX quantity and is not counted as traded
fixtures.basis: FIX Qty/float datatype: digits with an optional decimal point; design 13 'a finite number above zero'

fixtures.feature: LastQty '1e3' (exponent) is not a FIX quantity and is not counted as traded
fixtures.basis: FIX Qty/float datatype: digits with an optional decimal point; design 13 'a finite number above zero'

fixtures.feature: LastQty ' 100 ' (spaces) is not a FIX quantity and is not counted as traded
fixtures.basis: FIX Qty/float datatype: digits with an optional decimal point; design 13 'a finite number above zero'

fixtures.feature: LastPx '0x10' is not a FIX price and gives no average
fixtures.basis: FIX Price/float datatype

title: The order banner takes the order's latest state from a resent older report

fixtures.feature: The order's latest state is not taken from a resent older report
fixtures.basis: Brief 6, 7 (duplicate and late reports); AC-036 takes the last ExecutionReport in the log

title: A message without BeginString disappears without an error

fixtures.feature: Missing BeginString: the message is reported as malformed
fixtures.basis: Brief 10; TR-002 'first three fields are not 8, 9 and 35' but 'a message starts at 8=FIX'

title: A wire-valid message with ISO-8859-1 text is reported as malformed

fixtures.feature: A wire-valid message with ISO-8859-1 text (one byte per character) is not called malformed
fixtures.basis: FIX messages are bytes, and BodyLength/CheckSum count bytes; design 3.7 counts the UTF-8 bytes of the pasted characters

title: A valid multiple-value field is labelled 'unknown value'

fixtures.feature: A multiple-value field (ExecInst 18=1 6) is not called an unknown value
fixtures.basis: FIX 4.2/4.4 ExecInst (18) is a MultipleValueString; AC-004 'an enum value missing from the dictionary'

fixtures.feature: A multiple-value field (ExecInst 18=1 6) is not called an unknown value
fixtures.basis: FIX 4.2/4.4 ExecInst (18) is a MultipleValueString; AC-004 'an enum value missing from the dictionary'

title: An average price that ends exactly on a half is rounded down

fixtures.feature: Average price (1 x 1.005 + 1 x 1.0001) / 2 = 1.00255 exactly is shown as 1.0026
fixtures.basis: AC-045; the PRD names no rounding mode, but half-up and half-even both give 1.0026

title: Figures finer than 4 decimal places or larger than 2^53 are shown as other values

fixtures.feature: Very large quantities are summed exactly
fixtures.basis: Brief 7, 10 (decimal arithmetic, extremely large values)

fixtures.feature: Quantities and prices finer than 4 decimal places are not shown as other values
fixtures.basis: Brief 7 (decimal arithmetic); design 13 'Figures' rounds every figure to 4 places
